# X-ion Documentation

> Documentation for the X-ion Organization product ecosystem, including Scrutium AI, Draft, user guides, integrations, security guidance, and developer resources.

## Start here
- [Introduction](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/getting-started/introduction): Start exploring the documentation.
- [Platform overview](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/platform/overview): Understand the product ecosystem.
- [Product directory](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/products/overview): Browse documented products.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/getting-started/troubleshooting): Diagnose common issues.

## Products
- [Scrutium AI](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/products/scrutium-ai): AI workspace overview.
- [Draft](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/products/draft): Campaign and content workflow overview.
- [Draft integrations](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/products/draft-integrations): Integration prerequisites and guidance.

## Guides
- [Writing effective prompts](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/chat/prompting): Prompting practices.
- [Research workflows](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/research/overview): Research planning and source evaluation.
- [Workspaces and collaboration](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/workspaces/overview): Organizing work and access.
- [Account security](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/account/security): Protecting accounts and credentials.
- [Privacy and data](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/account/privacy): Account privacy guidance.

## Developers
- [API integration](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/developers/api-integration): API setup guidance.
- [API integration concepts](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/developers/api-concepts): Common API concepts and security practices.
- [Environment variables](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/developers/environment): Deployment configuration checklist.
- [Errors and debugging](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/developers/errors-and-debugging): Diagnose integration problems.

## Product updates and policies
- [Product updates](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/resources/changelog): Release notes home.
- [Policies and documentation scope](https://docs.scrutium.com/docs/resources/policies-and-terms): Policy and accuracy guidance.

The canonical domain in this index should be updated if the documentation site uses a different production hostname. The existence of a link does not imply that every described integration or capability is enabled in every deployment.
